title: The Limits of China’s Self-Sufficiency
summary: Joel Wuthnow argues that the PRC’s food insecurity could constrain Beijing’s willingness to launch a war over Taiwan. Although the PRC has pursued agricultural self-sufficiency, it still depends on imported soybeans, feed grains, fertilizer inputs, and foreign shipping routes vulnerable to blockade or sanctions.

title: The Little-Known Chinese Bank in the Middle of Iranian and Russian Money Flows
summary: Zhejiang Chouzhou Commercial Bank emerged as a frequent conduit for Iranian and Russian payments used to buy Chinese goods, including items with possible military applications. Documents link accounts at the regional lender to Iran’s shadow banking system and Russia’s state-backed A7 sanctions-evasion network.
